title: Valve says it might have to raise the price of supply-limited Steam Machines
summary: "We don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price..."
llm_summary: Valve has warned that because it still doesn’t know how many Steam Machines it can produce, it may have to increase their retail price to match the limited supply. The company’s uncertainty about manufacturing capacity means that early adopters could face higher costs if production volumes stay low. This potential price hike underscores the challenges of bringing a new, hardware‑focused platform to market.
